skill.name: softsync-portals
skill.description: Set up small sites where customers, members or partners sign in to see and update their own records, fill a form or book a meeting. Use when the user wants a customer portal, or to change, switch off or renew the link of one.
skill.summary: Create and manage SoftSync portals with record pages, editable fields, forms, bookings, and public link controls.
skill.author: softsync-lab

content.value_statement: Customers, members, and partners need access to selected workspace records without joining the workspace. This skill guides SoftSync portal setup, page configuration, and link management.
actual_capabilities: List portals and retrieve their pages and public links while enabled.
Create portals with a title, group, sign-in table, and page configuration.
Configure record pages with relationship paths, visible fields, and editable fields.
Include pages for existing forms or meeting types.
Update selected portal settings while preserving pages through a read-before-update workflow.
Renew portal links or delete portals after confirming the immediate access impact.
limitations: Portal management requires the Admin role and access to the referenced SoftSync tools.
The skill provides instructions, not an API client or a standalone portal application.
Sending pages during an update replaces the entire page list.
Omitting contactTableId permits public viewing; renewing or deleting a link immediately disrupts visitor access.

use_cases.title: Create Customer Record Access
use_cases.description: Configure a portal where customers sign in to view selected records and edit approved fields.

use_cases.title: Offer Member Forms and Bookings
use_cases.description: Assemble portal pages that expose an existing form and meeting type to members.

use_cases.title: Maintain Partner Portal Access
use_cases.description: Review partner portal settings, update pages, or renew a link after confirming the impact on current visitors.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Portals
prompt_templates.prompt: List my SoftSync portals and show their pages and public links where available. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Customer Portal
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a customer portal. Inspect the workspace schema, ask which contacts can sign in, and confirm visible and editable fields.

prompt_templates.title: Add Form and Booking Pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Add my selected existing form and meeting type to this portal. Read its current pages first and preserve every unrelated page.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: update a complete page list without removing existing pages.

prompt_templates.title: Renew a Portal Link
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this portal before renewing its link. Explain which visitors lose access, ask for confirmation, and proceed only after I approve.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: manage an access-disrupting link change.

output_examples.input: Help me set up a portal where customers can update their phone number.
output: Setup review: identify the contact table and phone field from the workspace schema.
Access plan: require customer sign-in and show each contact their own record.
Editing plan: allow changes only to the phone field.
Provide the portal title and group to complete the configuration.

output_examples.input: Renew the link for our partner portal.
output: Confirmation required: renewing the link invalidates the previous link immediately.
Visitors signed in through the previous link will lose access.
No change has been made. Confirm whether to proceed.

best_practices: Resolve table and field identifiers through describe_workspace_schema before configuring record pages.
Read the current portal before updating pages, because the supplied page list replaces all existing pages.
Choose sign-in requirements and editable fields explicitly; confirm before disabling, renewing, or deleting portal access.
anti_patterns: Omitting contactTableId when the intended audience must sign in.
Sending only a new page during an update and unintentionally removing existing pages.
Renewing or deleting a portal link without confirming the immediate loss of visitor access.

faq.question: Which permissions are required?
faq.answer: Portal management requires the Admin role.

faq.question: Can visitors use a portal without signing in?
faq.answer: Yes. Omitting contactTableId allows anyone to view the portal, so choose this setting deliberately.

faq.question: Can visitors edit every displayed field?
faq.answer: No. Visible fields use fieldIds, while editable fields are specified separately through editFieldIds.

faq.question: What happens when I update portal pages?
faq.answer: The supplied pages replace the complete page list. Read the current configuration first and retain pages that should remain.

faq.question: What happens when I renew a portal link?
faq.answer: The old link stops working immediately, and visitors signed in through it lose access. The skill requires confirmation first.

faq.question: Does this skill include the SoftSync tools?
faq.answer: No. It documents workflows for existing SoftSync tools; access to those tools must already be available.
